About Abdur-Rahman Sanni

Your Coach.
Your Results.

Whether your goal is to lose weight, build muscle, recover from injury or move without pain, every programme is tailored to your individual needs.

My coaching bridges the gap between rehabilitation and performance. I assess how you move to identify mobility restrictions, movement compensations, strength deficits and stability requirements before creating a personalised programme. With extensive experience supporting people with a wide range of complex health conditions, I help clients train safely, build confidence and achieve long-term results.

By building strong foundations first, you can train safely, perform better and achieve long-term results.

Level 4 Low Back Pain Specialist
Exercise Referral Specialist
Former NHS Pain Management & Wellbeing Coach

Specialist Areas

Where Expertise
Makes The Difference

Movement & Performance Coaching

Helping you move better and perform at your best through targeted coaching, movement assessment and personalised programming.

Lower Back Rehabilitation

Evidence-informed protocols to rebuild strength and mobility after lower back pain — safely and progressively.

Exercise Referral

Working alongside medical professionals for clients referred for exercise as part of their health management plan.

Advanced Boxercise Coaching

High-intensity boxing fitness sessions to build cardio, coordination, strength, and lasting confidence.
